aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abi-albon.title: Abi-albon
abi-albon.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abi-albon.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

abiathar.title: Abiathar
abiathar.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
abiathar.note: He was the only priest to get out of Nob alive when Saul had the place killed, and he went straight to David and stayed his priest through the running years and the reign. At the end he backed Adonijah instead of Solomon, and Solomon sent him away from the priesthood rather than kill him.

abiezer.title: Abiezer
abiezer.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abiezer.note: A warrior from the united-kingdom years who carries the clan's name. Nothing links him to Gideon's family beyond the spelling.

abimelech.title: Abimelech
abimelech.note: Gideon's son by a concubine. He killed almost all seventy of his brothers to clear his own way, which is most of what Judges has to say about him.

abinadab-2.title: Abinadab
abinadab-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
abinadab-2.note: The man whose house held the ark. It sat there twenty years before David came for it.

abishai.title: Abishai
abishai.about: David's warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abishai.note: David's nephew, and the most willing man he had. He is credited with three hundred killed on his own. Twice he offered to finish one of David's enemies on the spot, Saul asleep in the camp and Shimei cursing on the road, and both times David told him no.

abraham.title: Abraham
abraham.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abraham.note: God called him out of Ur and he went at seventy-five, which is most of what you need to know about him. The nation came out of that.

adina.title: Adina
adina.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adina.note: He was a Reubenite who led thirty men, and he served among David's warriors.

adullam.title: Adullam
adullam.note: A Canaanite royal city in the Shephelah, near the valley of Elah. David killed Goliath in that valley. Later, running from Saul, he hid in a cave near Adullam, and his family joined him there, and so did everyone in distress.

ahiam.title: Ahiam
ahiam.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ahiam.note: Son of Sharar the Hararite, and one of David's thirty mighty warriors. Chronicles calls his father Sacar. Nothing further is recorded.

ahiezer-2.title: Ahiezer
ahiezer-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahiezer-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

ahijah-2.title: Ahijah
ahijah-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahijah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

ahilud.title: Ahilud
ahilud.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahilud.note: Two of his sons served kings: Jehoshaphat was David's royal recorder, and Baana governed one of Solomon's twelve districts.

ahio.title: Ahio
ahio.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahio.note: He and his brother Uzzah were guiding the cart that carried the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem. Uzzah reached out to steady it and was struck dead.

ahitub-2.title: Ahitub
ahitub-2.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahitub-2.note: Zadok's father, named in the list of officials at 2 Samuel 8:17 and in the priestly genealogy of Chronicles.

ahlai.title: Ahlai
ahlai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahlai.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

ahohite.title: Ahohite
ahohite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahohite.note: Three of David's fighting men carry this label, marking them as descendants of Ahoah: Dodo, his son Eleazar, who was among the three mightiest, and Zalmon of the thirty.

alamoth.title: Alamoth
alamoth.note: It literally means maidens, and it turns up in the temple records and in a psalm heading, probably marking a high part.

amalek.title: Amalek
amalek.note: Esau's grandson. The Amalekites who came from him attacked the weak rear of Israel's column in the wilderness, and God declared war on Amalek for it. Saul's half-done obedience against them later cost him the kingdom.

amasai-3.title: Amasai
amasai-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amasai-3.note: One of 4 men called Amasai. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

amasai-2.title: Amasai
amasai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amasai-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

amminadab-2.title: Amminadab
amminadab-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amminadab-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ammon.title: Ammon
ammon.note: A nation east of the Jordan, descended from Lot through his younger daughter and close kin to Moab. The Ammonites fought Israel again and again, from Jephthah's war in Judges to the insult to David's envoys that started a full war in David's reign.

aram.title: Aram
aram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
aram.note: It is what the Old Testament calls Syria, the region and people centred on Damascus. Under kings like Ben-hadad and Hazael it fought both Israelite kingdoms again and again.

aram-naharaim.title: Aram-naharaim
aram-naharaim.note: Aram of the two rivers, upper Mesopotamia. Abraham's relatives settled there, and the wives of Isaac and Jacob came from it.

arbahite.title: Arbahite
arbahite.note: It marks Abi-albon, one of David's mighty men, as a man of Beth-arabah, a town in the Arabah plain near the Dead Sea.

aroerite.title: Aroerite
aroerite.note: Hothan, father of two of David's mighty men, Shama and Jehiel, came from Aroer. Most likely that means the town on the Arnon gorge rather than the one near Beersheba.

asahel.title: Asahel
asahel.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
asahel.note: Joab's younger brother, one of David's best warriors and famous for his speed. He died chasing Abner in the fighting between David's side and Saul's. Joab later murdered Abner for it, and that killing hung over David's reign.

asaiah-2.title: Asaiah
asaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

asaph.title: Asaph
asaph.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaph.note: A Levite David put in charge of one of the temple choirs. Twelve psalms carry his name, Psalm 50 and Psalms 73 to 83, which means either he wrote them or a guild of musicians kept his name for generations.

asher.title: Asher
asher.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
asher.note: Jacob's eighth son, by Leah's servant Zilpah. His tribe got a fertile coastal strip in the north, running toward Phoenicia, some of the richest land in Israel. Beyond its borders and city list little of the tribe's own history is recorded, and like Simeon it produced no judge or great hero.

ashterathite.title: Ashterathite
ashterathite.note: Uzzia, one of David's mighty men, came from Ashtaroth, the Bashan city that had been the capital of Og's Amorite kingdom.

attai-2.title: Attai
attai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
attai-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

azarael-2.title: Azarael
azarael-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azarael-2.note: One of several men called Azarel in Chronicles, this one in the list at 1 Chronicles 12:6.

azaziah.title: Azaziah
azaziah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azaziah.note: One of the musicians appointed under David, at 1 Chronicles 15:21.

aziel.title: Aziel
aziel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
aziel.note: He played the psaltery when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem. The name seems to be short for Jaaziel, two verses earlier in the same list.

azmaveth-3.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azmaveth-3.note: One of 4 men called Azmaveth. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

azmaveth.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
azmaveth.note: He fought for David and made the list of David's thirty. The same name belonged to a town near Jerusalem and to several other men. His own record is a line in each of the two lists of the thirty.

baal-perazim.title: Baal-perazim
baal-perazim.note: David named it, lord of breakthroughs more or less, after beating the Philistines there early in his reign over all Israel and comparing the win to floodwater breaking through.

baanah-2.title: Baanah
baanah-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
baanah-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

baharumite.title: Baharumite
baharumite.note: It tells you where a man came from. Azmaveth, one of David's mighty men, was from Bahurim, a Benjaminite village east of Jerusalem on the road to the Jordan. The parallel list in 2 Samuel 23:31 spells it Barhumite.

bealiah.title: Bealiah
bealiah.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bealiah.note: He was a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag while David was still on the run from Saul. He was one of the skilled warriors who could use bow and sling with either hand.

beeliada.title: Beeliada
beeliada.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
beeliada.note: David's son, born in Jerusalem. The other lists call him Eliada, and Beeliada looks like the earlier form of the name, later avoided.

ben.title: Ben
ben.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ben.note: He was one of the gatekeepers David put over the ark of the covenant, in the list at 1 Chronicles 15:18. He does not reappear in the parallel list a few verses on.

benaiah-2.title: Benaiah
benaiah-2.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
benaiah-2.note: A singer from David's time, listed among the musicians in 1 Chronicles 15 and 16. The Benaiah who led David's bodyguard is another man.

benaiah.title: Benaiah
benaiah.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
benaiah.note: He commanded David's bodyguard, and before that he was known for killing a lion in a pit on a snowy day. He also beat an Egyptian giant by wrestling the giant's own spear off him and killing him with it.

benaiah-3.title: Benaiah
benaiah-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
benaiah-3.note: Not the captain of the bodyguard but another of David's warriors with the same name. He turns up in 2 Samuel 23:30 and twice in Chronicles.

benjamin.title: Benjamin
benjamin.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
benjamin.note: Jacob's twelfth son and the youngest, born to Rachel on the road near Bethlehem as she died giving birth to him. Jacob guarded him fiercely after losing Joseph. That fear drives much of the tension in Joseph's story.

berachah.title: Berachah
berachah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
berachah.note: It means blessing. This Berachah was a Benjamite warrior, one of Saul's kinsmen, who joined David at Ziklag. A Valley of Berachah near Tekoa has nothing to do with him.

berachiah.title: Berachiah
berachiah.about: Asaph's father living at the time of Divided Monarchy
berachiah.note: Asaph's father. Chronicles names him in the family line at 1 Chronicles 6:39 and twice more in chapter 15.

berothite.title: Berothite
berothite.note: It tells you Naharai, Joab's armor-bearer and one of David's mighty men, came from Beeroth, a Gibeonite city allotted to Benjamin.

bethlehem.title: Bethlehem
bethlehem.note: House of bread. It is a small town about five miles south of Jerusalem, earlier called Ephrath, where Rachel died and was buried and where Ruth gleaned in Boaz's fields. David was born there and anointed there.

canaan.title: Canaan
canaan.note: The land promised to Abraham and his descendants, roughly modern Israel and the land around it. The conquest under Joshua is that promise, centuries old by then, being kept.

canan-4.title: Canan
canan-4.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
canan-4.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

carmelite.title: Carmelite
carmelite.note: Here it means someone from Carmel in Judah's hill country, not Mount Carmel in the north. Nabal was a Carmelite, the rich fool who insulted David, and so was his wife Abigail, who married David after Nabal died.

chenaniah.title: Chenaniah
chenaniah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chenaniah.note: David put this Levite in charge of the music when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem, because he was good at it.

cherethims.title: Cherethims
cherethims.about: A military group in the Old Testament
cherethims.note: David's bodyguard, with the Pelethites, under Benaiah's command. They were tied closely to the Philistines and likely came from Crete.

chidon.title: Chidon
chidon.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
chidon.note: The threshing floor where Uzzah put his hand on the ark and died, on the road toward Jerusalem; 2 Samuel calls the same spot Nachon's threshing floor.

chun.title: Chun
chun.note: David took bronze from this city of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, and the bronze later went into Solomon's temple. 2 Samuel calls it Berothai. It probably lay somewhere in the Beqaa Valley of Lebanon.

david.title: David
david.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
david.note: The shepherd from Bethlehem who killed Goliath and became Israel's second king, ruling a kingdom bigger than any native king held before or after. Solomon was one of his sons. Nearly half the psalms carry his name, and the Tel Dan inscription, where an enemy king boasts over the house of David, put his dynasty outside the Bible as well.

dodo.title: Dodo
dodo.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
dodo.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

dodo-2.title: Dodo
dodo-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
dodo-2.note: Father of one of David's mighty men, named only so that his son can be.

edom.title: Edom
edom.note: Esau got the byname Edom over a bowl of red stew, and it stuck to the mountain country his descendants settled southeast of the Dead Sea. Bozrah was its old capital and Sela, the Greeks' Petra, its rock fortress. Edom refused Israel passage in the exodus and later helped Babylon sack Jerusalem, and the prophets did not let that go.

egypt.title: Egypt
egypt.note: Joseph rose to power there and kept his family alive through the famine. A later pharaoh enslaved their descendants, and that set up the exodus. For the rest of the Old Testament Egypt stands for the slavery Israel was brought out of, and Matthew has Jesus's family flee there from Herod as if living that story again.

eleazar-3.title: Eleazar
eleazar-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
eleazar-3.note: One of 8 men called Eleazar. This one is a warrior from the united kingdom, named twice in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

eliab-5.title: Eliab
eliab-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliab-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliab-4.title: Eliab
eliab-4.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliab-4.note: One of the singers and players when David brought the ark up, named in 1 Chronicles 15 and 16.

eliahbah.title: Eliahbah
eliahbah.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
eliahbah.note: A Shaalbonite on the roll of David's thirty mighty men. No deed of his is recorded.

eliel.title: Eliel
eliel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel.note: A common name among Levitical officials and David's warriors in Chronicles. This one is named among the Levitical officials called up when the ark was brought to Jerusalem.

eliel-4.title: Eliel
eliel-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-4.note: One of 8 men called Eliel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 12:11.

eliel-2.title: Eliel
eliel-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-2.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliel-3.title: Eliel
eliel-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 1 Chronicles 11:47.

eliezer-2.title: Eliezer
eliezer-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliezer-2.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elihu-2.title: Elihu
elihu-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihu-2.note: One of 5 men called Elihu. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

eliphal.title: Eliphal
eliphal.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliphal.note: Son of Ur and one of David's mighty men in Chronicles, apparently the man 2 Samuel calls Eliphelet son of Ahasbai.

eliphalet.title: Eliphalet
eliphalet.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
eliphalet.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, a name David used more than once.

elipheleh.title: Elipheleh
elipheleh.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elipheleh.note: A Levite who played the harp on the Sheminith when David brought the ark up to Jerusalem. Nobody is sure what Sheminith means; it may be an instrument, a tuning or an octave.

elishama-2.title: Elishama
elishama-2.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
elishama-2.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, in the lists of 2 Samuel 5 and 1 Chronicles 3 and 14.

elishua.title: Elishua
elishua.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
elishua.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, and listed as Elishama in 1 Chronicles 3.

elizaphan.title: Elizaphan
elizaphan.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elizaphan.note: He led the Kohathite Levites in the wilderness. When Nadab and Abihu died for offering unauthorized fire, he was one of those who carried the bodies out.

elkanah-6.title: Elkanah
elkanah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elkanah-6.note: One of 8 men called Elkanah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

elkanah-5.title: Elkanah
elkanah-5.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elkanah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

elkanan.title: Elkanan
elkanan.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
elkanan.note: Elhanan, a warrior in David's army. 2 Samuel credits him with killing Goliath the Gittite, and 1 Chronicles says it was Goliath's brother Lahmi, which takes the clash out of David's story.

elkanan-2.title: Elkanan
elkanan-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
elkanan-2.note: 2 Samuel credits him with killing Goliath the Gittite. 1 Chronicles says it was Goliath's brother Lahmi. That is how the two accounts are usually squared.

elnaam.title: Elnaam
elnaam.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elnaam.note: His two sons, Jeribai and Joshaviah, are on the longer roll of David's warriors in Chronicles.

eluzai.title: Eluzai
eluzai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eluzai.note: A Benjamite who came over to David at Ziklag while David was still an outlaw. He was one of the fighters who could use bow and sling with either hand.

elzabad.title: Elzabad
elzabad.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elzabad.note: A Gadite who joined David at Ziklag before he was king, sharing the name with a Korahite gatekeeper in Chronicles.

ephraim.title: Ephraim
ephraim.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephraim.note: Joseph's younger son. When Jacob blessed the two boys he crossed his hands on purpose and gave Ephraim the bigger blessing over Manasseh. The tribe came to dominate the north so much that the prophets use Ephraim for the whole northern kingdom.

ethan.title: Ethan
ethan.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ethan.note: In 1 Kings Ethan is one of the wise men Solomon outdid, and Psalm 89 is credited to Ethan the Ezrahite, possibly the same man. The name also turns up among the singers of Chronicles.

euphrates.title: Euphrates
euphrates.note: The great river. It rises in the Armenian highlands and runs some seventeen hundred miles to the Persian Gulf. Genesis has it as one of Eden's four rivers, the promise to Abraham reaches to it, and later Assyria and Babylon came from beyond it.

ezbai.title: Ezbai
ezbai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezbai.note: Father of Naarai, one of David's mighty men, and nothing further is recorded.

ezer-2.title: Ezer
ezer-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezer-2.note: One of 5 men called Ezer. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

gaash.title: Gaash
gaash.note: Joshua was buried near this hill in Ephraim, close to Timnath-heres.

gad.title: Gad
gad.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
gad.note: Jacob's seventh son, born to Leah's servant Zilpah. His tribe asked for good pasture east of the Jordan and got it. The condition was that Gad's fighting men still crossed over and helped the other tribes take their land first.

gareb.title: Gareb
gareb.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
gareb.note: One of David's mighty warriors. There is also a hill near Jerusalem called Gareb, in Jeremiah, which is a different thing entirely.

gath.title: Gath
gath.note: Goliath's hometown, one of the five Philistine cities. The captured ark brought disaster on it, David later hid there with King Achish while running from Saul, and in the end David took it. Most identify it with Tell es-Safi, where a potsherd turned up carrying two names related to Goliath.

gazer.title: Gazer
gazer.note: The same city as Gezer. Pharaoh took it and gave it to his daughter when she married Solomon, and Solomon fortified it along with Hazor and Megiddo. The Gezer Calendar, a little tablet of farming seasons in early Hebrew script, was found there.

gederathite.title: Gederathite
gederathite.note: Josabad was one, a Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag while Saul was still hunting him.

gedor.title: Gedor
gedor.note: A town in the hill country of Judah between Jerusalem and Hebron, whose founders Chronicles traces through Hur and Ephrathah. The same name belongs to another place and to a man in Saul's family.

gershon.title: Gershon
gershon.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gershon.note: Levi's eldest son. His descendants carried the tabernacle's coverings, curtains and hangings by cart through the wilderness. Exodus 2:22 and 18:3, filed under this name, belong to a different man.

gibeathite.title: Gibeathite
gibeathite.note: Benjaminite archers and slingers from Gibeah, Saul's own town, who went over to David at Ziklag while he was still an outlaw.

gibeon.title: Gibeon
gibeon.note: They tricked Joshua into a treaty by dressing as travellers from far away, the Hivites of this city northwest of Jerusalem, and so they lived but served at Israel's sanctuary. The tabernacle stood at Gibeon for years, and Solomon had his dream there. At el-Jib dozens of jar handles stamped with the name have settled where it was.

gibeonite.title: Gibeonite
gibeonite.note: Saul broke the old treaty and killed some of them. Under David a famine followed, and it ended only when seven of Saul's descendants were handed over to the Gibeonites for execution.

gittite.title: Gittite
gittite.note: A man from Gath. Obed-edom the Gittite kept the ark in his house before David brought it up to Jerusalem, and Ittai the Gittite brought his foreign troops to David's side when Absalom rebelled.

gizonite.title: Gizonite
gizonite.note: Hashem, whose sons were among David's mighty men, came from Gizoh, a place in Judah's hill country otherwise unknown. In 2 Samuel 23:32 the same family is listed as Jashen.

goliath.title: Goliath
goliath.about: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
goliath.note: The Philistine champion from Gath whom the young David killed in the valley of Elah. The traditional Hebrew text makes him over nine feet, while the Dead Sea Scrolls and the earliest Greek give about six foot nine. One later passage credits Elhanan, and Chronicles makes Elhanan's man Goliath's brother.

hachmoni.title: Hachmoni
hachmoni.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hachmoni.note: The Hachmonite family name stands behind Jashobeam, one of David's chief warriors, and Jehiel, who attended David's sons, is called his son.

hadadezer.title: Hadadezer
hadadezer.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
hadadezer.note: David fought this Aramean king in campaign after campaign, and the wins pushed Israel's borders out and brought in tribute and a great deal of captured bronze.

hagarene.title: Hagarene
hagarene.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hagarene.note: They were nomads east of Gilead, beaten by Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh in a war Chronicles records.

hamath.title: Hamath
hamath.note: An Aramean capital on the Orontes in Upper Syria, the old northern limit of the land promised to Israel. Its king Toi was David's ally. Inscribed stones from the site, set up by a king the Assyrians called Irhuleni, were among the first Hieroglyphic Luwian texts European scholars saw, and reading his name gave them some of the script's first sign values.

hanun.title: Hanun
hanun.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
hanun.note: David sent men to comfort him when his father died, and the Ammonite king shaved off half their beards and cut their clothes short. It started a full war between Israel and Ammon with its Aramean allies.

hararite.title: Hararite
hararite.note: Roughly, the mountaineer. Three of David's mighty men carry it, among them Shammah son of Agee, who held a field of lentils against a Philistine raid on his own.

harorite.title: Harorite
harorite.note: It is what Chronicles calls Shammoth, one of David's mighty men, where Samuel's list has Shammah the Harodite.

haruphite.title: Haruphite
haruphite.note: Shephatiah, a Benjamite archer and slinger, came from Hariph and joined David at Ziklag while David was still hiding from Saul.

hashem.title: Hashem
hashem.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
hashem.note: A Gizonite. His sons were among David's mighty men. Samuel's parallel list calls him Jashen.

hebron.title: Hebron
hebron.note: Abraham camped near here at Mamre and bought the cave of Machpelah to bury Sarah. It sits in the hill country south of Jerusalem, once called Kirjath-arba, and Joshua gave it to Caleb. David reigned there seven years before moving to Jerusalem, and Herod's great stone enclosure over the traditional tomb still stands.

hebron-2.title: Hebron
hebron-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebron-2.note: Kohath's son, a Levite, and a clan of Levites came from him.

heled.title: Heled
heled.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
heled.note: Chronicles has this name among David's thirty where Samuel has Heleb son of Baanah.

helez.title: Helez
helez.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy

heman.title: Heman
heman.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
heman.note: David put him among the chief musicians over the worship, a Levite. Psalm 88, one of the darkest laments in the book, is credited to him.

hepher-3.title: Hepher
hepher-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hepher-3.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

hezro.title: Hezro
hezro.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
hezro.note: Called the Carmelite, he stands among David's mighty warriors in both lists of them. Nothing else is recorded about him.

hittite.title: Hittite
hittite.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hittite.note: Ephron the Hittite sold Abraham the cave of Machpelah at Hebron, and Uriah, the soldier whose wife David took, was a Hittite too. Critics once doubted there was ever a Hittite nation, until digs at Boghazkoy in Turkey found its capital. The Hittites in Canaan were probably a smaller offshoot, or the name used loosely.

hosah.title: Hosah
hosah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hosah.note: A Levite of Merari's family whom David made a gatekeeper, and his family kept the post after him.

hotham.title: Hotham
hotham.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hotham.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

hurai.title: Hurai
hurai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
hurai.note: Chronicles' name for one of David's thirty, from the valley by Mount Gaash in Ephraim. Samuel's list calls him Hiddai.

huram.title: Huram
huram.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
huram.note: Chronicles spells the king of Tyre this way. He is the Hiram who sent materials for Solomon's temple.

hushathite.title: Hushathite
hushathite.note: Two of David's mighty men carry this label, Sibbecai and Mebunnai, and it ties them to Hushah in Judah's genealogy. Sibbecai is also the one who killed a Philistine giant in a later battle at Gob.

ibhar.title: Ibhar
ibhar.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
ibhar.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, after he was king, and nothing more.

ikkesh.title: Ikkesh
ikkesh.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ikkesh.note: His son Ira, from Tekoa, was one of David's mighty warriors.

ilai.title: Ilai
ilai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ilai.note: An Ahohite among David's chief warriors. Samuel's list has Zalmon in his place.

ira-2.title: Ira
ira-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ira-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

ira.title: Ira
ira.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ira.note: One of David's elite warriors, who in Chronicles also commands one of the monthly army divisions. Ira was the name of more than one of David's men.

isaac.title: Isaac
isaac.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
isaac.note: Abraham and Sarah's promised son, born when his father was a hundred. God told Abraham to sacrifice him on Mount Moriah and provided a ram at the last moment. Old and blind, he was tricked by Jacob into giving him Esau's blessing, and he never left Canaan or took a second wife.

ishiah-2.title: Ishiah
ishiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishiah-2.note: One of 5 men called Ishiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ishmaiah.title: Ishmaiah
ishmaiah.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmaiah.note: A Gibeonite who came over to David at Ziklag while David was still on the run from Saul, and a leader among the thirty.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

issachar.title: Issachar
issachar.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
issachar.note: Jacob's ninth son. His tribe held the fertile Jezreel Valley, and Chronicles says its men understood the times and knew what Israel ought to do.

ithai-2.title: Ithai
ithai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ithai-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

ithmah.title: Ithmah
ithmah.about: Moabite warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ithmah.note: David's mighty men included a Moabite, and this is him.

ithrite.title: Ithrite
ithrite.note: Ira and Gareb, two of David's mighty men, both carry this label. It may tie them to Kiriath-jearim, but where the name comes from is not known for sure.

jaasiel.title: Jaasiel
jaasiel.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaasiel.note: He is Jasiel the Mesobaite in the roll of David's mighty warriors.

jaaziel.title: Jaaziel
jaaziel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaaziel.note: He played the harp when David brought the ark up to Jerusalem, and he is probably the Aziel named two verses later.

jacob.title: Jacob
jacob.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
jacob.note: Isaac and Rebekah's younger twin, born holding Esau's heel. He bought his brother's birthright for stew, took his father's blessing by a trick, and ran to his uncle Laban, where he worked fourteen years for Leah and Rachel. On the way home he wrestled all night and came away named Israel. He died in Egypt, near Joseph, and was buried at Machpelah as he had asked.

jahaziel-3.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahaziel-3.note: One of 5 men called Jahaziel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jahaziel-2.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahaziel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

jair-3.title: Jair
jair-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
jair-3.note: Not the judge, and not Jair of Gilead. This Jair was father of Elhanan, the warrior of David's who killed Lahmi, Goliath's brother.

japhia.title: Japhia
japhia.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
japhia.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, and sharing his name with a king of Lachish and a town of Zebulun.

jashobeam.title: Jashobeam
jashobeam.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jashobeam.note: Chief of David's three greatest warriors, credited with killing three hundred men in one fight.

jashobeam-2.title: Jashobeam
jashobeam-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jashobeam-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

jebus.title: Jebus
jebus.note: What Jerusalem was called while the Jebusites held it. David took it and made it his capital.

jediael-3.title: Jediael
jediael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jediael-3.note: One of 4 men called Jediael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jediael-2.title: Jediael
jediael-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jediael-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

jeduthun.title: Jeduthun
jeduthun.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
jeduthun.note: David put three chief musicians over temple worship, Heman, Asaph and Jeduthun. Several psalms carry Jeduthun's name in their headings.

jehiah.title: Jehiah
jehiah.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehiah.note: He kept the door for the ark, with Obed-edom, when David brought it to Jerusalem.

jehiel.title: Jehiel
jehiel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehiel.note: One of the temple musicians David appointed when the ark came up, playing before it. The name was common in Levitical families in Chronicles.

jehoiada-2.title: Jehoiada
jehoiada-2.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jehoiada-2.note: Known through his son, the commander of David's bodyguard who carried out the killings after David's death, in Samuel and Kings.

jehoshaphat-2.title: Jehoshaphat
jehoshaphat-2.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jehoshaphat-2.note: David's recorder, the official who kept the court's records, and he still held the post in the next reign.

jehu-3.title: Jehu
jehu-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehu-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

jeiel.title: Jeiel
jeiel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeiel.note: One of the temple musicians when the ark came up. The name turns up often in Chronicles, for singers, scribes and officials.

jeiel-2.title: Jeiel
jeiel-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeiel-2.note: One of 7 men called Jeiel. This one is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jeremiah-4.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeremiah-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jeremiah-5.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeremiah-5.note: One of 8 men called Jeremiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jeremiah-6.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeremiah-6.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

jeribai.title: Jeribai
jeribai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeribai.note: One of David's mighty men, Elnaam's son, though he comes in the later additions to the list and not the core thirty.

jericho.title: Jericho
jericho.note: Israel crossed the Jordan and Jericho was the first city it took, walled and gated, with its own king. Achan died for what he stole from the plunder there, a Babylonian robe and silver that belonged to God. By then the place was already ancient: digging at the site has turned up remains about ten thousand years old.

jermoth.title: Jermoth
jermoth.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jermoth.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jeroham-3.title: Jeroham
jeroham-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeroham-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: David took it from the Jebusites and made it his capital, and once Solomon's temple stood there it was the centre of Israel's worship for a thousand years. Babylon destroyed it, the exiles rebuilt it, Rome destroyed it again in AD 70. Jesus died and rose just outside its walls, and Revelation ends with a new Jerusalem coming down from heaven.

jesse.title: Jesse
jesse.about: David's father living at the time of United Monarchy
jesse.note: Obed's son and Boaz and Ruth's grandson, a man of some standing in Bethlehem with eight sons, the youngest David. Isaiah's "stem of Jesse" is David's family, and the "root of Jesse" is the Messiah. The last we see of him, David is getting him a safe place with the king of Moab.

jeziel.title: Jeziel
jeziel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeziel.note: Azmaveth's son, a Benjamite archer who could sling stones and shoot arrows with either hand. He came over to David at Ziklag while David was still hiding from Saul, one of the early men from Saul's own tribe.

joab.title: Joab
joab.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
joab.note: David's nephew, and the commander of his army for most of the reign. He was loyal to what David needed rather than what David said: he arranged Uriah's death when asked, killed Absalom when told not to, and murdered Abner and Amasa under cover of friendship. David never forgave Absalom. On David's word Solomon had Joab killed, even holding on to the altar.

joash-5.title: Joash
joash-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joash-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 1 Chronicles 12:3.

joel.title: Joel
joel.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
joel.note: Samuel's son, and not the prophet. Chronicles puts him in the Levite lists, and he is the father in a line of temple singers.

joel-2.title: Joel
joel-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

joel-5.title: Joel
joel-5.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
joel-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

joelah.title: Joelah
joelah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joelah.note: A Benjamite warrior, from Saul's own tribe, who came over to David while he was still an outlaw at Ziklag.

joezer.title: Joezer
joezer.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joezer.note: One of the Korahites who came to David at Ziklag while he was still running from Saul, in a band of archers and slingers who could fight with either hand.

joha.title: Joha
joha.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joha.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

johanan.title: Johanan
johanan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
johanan.note: He commanded troops after Jerusalem fell and warned Gedaliah, the new governor, that someone was coming to kill him. Gedaliah would not believe it, and the plot went through.

jonathan.title: Jonathan
jonathan.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jonathan.note: Saul's eldest son, heir to the throne, and David's friend. He made a covenant with David knowing it cost him the crown. Once, with only his armour-bearer, he climbed a cliff and started a rout of the Philistine army. He died with Saul and two brothers on Mount Gilboa, and David's lament for him says his love was "surpassing the love of women."

jonathan-5.title: Jonathan
jonathan-5.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
jonathan-5.note: A warrior from the united kingdom. 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice.

joram-4.title: Joram
joram-4.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
joram-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

jordan.title: Jordan
jordan.note: It runs from the slopes of Mount Hermon through the Sea of Galilee and down the Rift Valley to the Dead Sea, about sixty five miles in a straight line and nearer two hundred as the river winds. Israel crossed it on dry ground under Joshua, Elijah and Elisha each parted it, and John the Baptist baptised Jesus in it.

josabad.title: Josabad
josabad.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
josabad.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

josabad-2.title: Josabad
josabad-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
josabad-2.note: He came over to David while David was still running from Saul, and became one of his best soldiers.

joshaphat-2.title: Joshaphat
joshaphat-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joshaphat-2.note: A priest who blew a trumpet in front of the ark when David brought it up to Jerusalem.

joshaphat.title: Joshaphat
joshaphat.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joshaphat.note: The Mithnite, one of David's mighty warriors.

joshaviah.title: Joshaviah
joshaviah.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joshaviah.note: Elnaam's son, and on the roster of David's mighty warriors.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

kabzeel.title: Kabzeel
kabzeel.note: The far south of Judah's land, out by the border with Edom. Benaiah came from there, one of David's best-known warriors and later head of his bodyguard. After the exile it seems to have been lived in again as Jekabzeel.

kirjath.title: Kirjath
kirjath.note: Kirjath-jearim, also called Baalah, a Gibeonite town on the line between Judah and Benjamin. The ark sat there twenty years after the Philistines gave it back, until David brought it up to Jerusalem. The prophet Uriah, whom Jehoiakim had killed, came from there.

kish.title: Kish
kish.about: Saul's father living at the time of United Monarchy
kish.note: Saul's father, a Benjamite of some standing. He lost his donkeys, sent Saul to find them, and the search ended with Samuel anointing Saul as Israel's first king.

kohath.title: Kohath
kohath.about: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kohath.note: Levi's second son. His descendants had the holiest work in the tabernacle, carrying the ark and the sacred furniture on poles, and even they would die if they touched those things.

kushaiah.title: Kushaiah
kushaiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
kushaiah.note: Ethan's father, a Merarite Levite, and Ethan sang among the musicians David appointed for bringing the ark up to Jerusalem. The other genealogy calls him Kishi.

lahmi.title: Lahmi
lahmi.about: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
lahmi.note: Goliath's brother, killed by Elhanan son of Jair in a fight between David's men and the Philistines.

levi.title: Levi
levi.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
levi.note: Jacob's third son. He and Simeon massacred the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped, and Jacob cursed them both for it on his deathbed. Even so, Levi's descendants became Israel's priestly tribe, given service at the tabernacle instead of land, partly for their zeal against the golden calf at Sinai.

maachah-2.title: Maachah
maachah-2.note: A small Aramean kingdom near Geshur, east of the Sea of Galilee. Israel never managed to drive it out.

maachah-6.title: Maachah
maachah-6.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maachah-6.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

maaseiah-2.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-2.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maaseiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

machbanai.title: Machbanai
machbanai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
machbanai.note: A Gadite, good with shield and spear, who came over to David while he was hiding from Saul in the wilderness.

maharai.title: Maharai
maharai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
maharai.note: From Netophah, one of David's mighty warriors, and later the commander of one of David's monthly army divisions.

mahavite.title: Mahavite
mahavite.note: An epithet, and it belongs to Eliel, one of David's mighty men. Nobody knows what place it points to.

manasseh.title: Manasseh
manasseh.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
manasseh.note: Joseph's elder son, whom Jacob took as his own and blessed. His name went to one of Israel's twelve tribes, and from Numbers through Joshua and Chronicles most of his verses are about that tribe and its land.

mattithiah-n.title: Mattithiah. n
mattithiah-n.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
mattithiah-n.note: A Levitical name, carried by several of the singers and gatekeepers David appointed.

mecherathite.title: Mecherathite
mecherathite.note: It tags Hepher, one of David's mighty men in Chronicles. The place is unknown, and the two lists of these men, in 2 Samuel 23 and 1 Chronicles 11, differ on names at exactly this kind of point.

medeba.title: Medeba
medeba.note: An old Moabite town given to Reuben. Joab beat the Ammonites and their Aramean allies near it in David's time, and Moab later took it back, which Isaiah mourns in his oracle against Moab. Today it is Madaba in Jordan, known for a sixth-century Byzantine floor mosaic that is the oldest surviving map of the Holy Land.

merari.title: Merari
merari.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
merari.note: Levi's third son. His descendants had the heavy parts of the tabernacle, the frames, bars, pillars and bases, which went by cart instead of being carried.

mesobaite.title: Mesobaite
mesobaite.note: The tag on Jasiel, one of the last names in the roll of David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles 11:47. Whatever place it means, perhaps Zobah, cannot be fixed.

mibhar.title: Mibhar
mibhar.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mibhar.note: A Hagrite among David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles 11:38. Second Samuel has Bani the Gadite in the same place, and most scholars think one name has been miscopied into the other.

michael-2.title: Michael
michael-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
michael-2.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verse is 1 Chronicles 12:20.

michal.title: Michal
michal.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
michal.note: Saul's younger daughter. David won her by killing two hundred Philistines, and she saved his life by letting him down through a window when Saul's men came. Saul then gave her to another man; David took her back as king, but she despised him for dancing before the ark, and she had no children to the end of her life.

mikneiah.title: Mikneiah
mikneiah.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mikneiah.note: A Levite of the second rank, gatekeeper and harp player in the choir that went with the ark up to Jerusalem.

mishmannah.title: Mishmannah
mishmannah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mishmannah.note: The Gadites who went over to David at Ziklag while he was running from Saul had faces like lions and were as quick as gazelles on the hills. Mishmannah was one of them.

mithnite.title: Mithnite
mithnite.note: Joshaphat's tag in the list of David's mighty men. The place it comes from is unknown.

moab.title: Moab
moab.note: East of the Dead Sea, the nation descended from Lot through his elder daughter. Israel and Moab went back and forth between enemies and kin: Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, and yet Ruth, a Moabite, became King David's great-grandmother. King Mesha's own inscription on the Moabite Stone records the wars with Israel that 2 Kings describes.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

naarai.title: Naarai
naarai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
naarai.note: One of David's mighty men. Second Samuel calls him Paarai the Arbite.

naharai.title: Naharai
naharai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
naharai.note: From Beeroth. He carried Joab's armour and is counted among David's mighty warriors.

nahash-2.title: Nahash
nahash-2.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
nahash-2.note: A king of the Ammonites. When he died, Israel's king sent men to comfort his son, and 2 Samuel 10 is the war that came out of how they were received.

naphtali.title: Naphtali
naphtali.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
naphtali.note: Jacob's sixth son, born to Rachel's servant Bilhah. His tribe settled in northern Galilee, the land Isaiah says will see a great light, and Matthew ties that to Jesus starting his work there.

nathan-2.title: Nathan
nathan-2.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
nathan-2.note: One of David's sons born in Jerusalem. Luke traces Jesus' line through him, not through Solomon.

nathan.title: Nathan
nathan.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
nathan.note: The prophet who told David the story of the rich man who took a poor man's only lamb, let David condemn the man, and then turned it on him over Bathsheba and Uriah. Earlier he had brought God's promise that David's house would last forever. When David was dying, Nathan helped put Solomon on the throne ahead of a rival half-brother.

nathan-3.title: Nathan
nathan-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
nathan-3.note: One of 6 men called Nathan. This one is a warrior from the united kingdom, named twice in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

nepheg.title: Nepheg
nepheg.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
nepheg.note: One of David's sons born in Jerusalem, and nothing more is told of him.

nethaneel-2.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nethaneel-2.note: One of 10 men called Nethaneel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

netophathite.title: Netophathite
netophathite.note: From Netophah, a small town near Bethlehem. Several of David's mighty men carried the name, and later some Levitical singers did too.

nogah.title: Nogah
nogah.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
nogah.note: Born to David in Jerusalem after he became king there. He is on two lists of David's sons and nowhere else.

obadiah-4.title: Obadiah
obadiah-4.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obadiah-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

obed-3.title: Obed
obed-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obed-3.note: One of 5 men called Obed. This one is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

obed-edom.title: Obed-edom
obed-edom.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
obed-edom.note: After Uzzah died, David would not take the ark any further and left it in Obed-edom's house for three months. It brought blessing on his whole household, and that was what got David moving again.

pas-dammim.title: Pas-dammim
pas-dammim.note: Eleazar son of Dodo held his ground here. It lay between Socoh and Azekah in the Valley of Elah, the same country where David killed Goliath. First Samuel calls it Ephes-dammim.

pelet.title: Pelet
pelet.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pelet.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

pelethites.title: Pelethites
pelethites.note: They always come paired with the Cherethites, as David's personal guard under Benaiah. The names sound foreign, and they were probably hired soldiers of Philistine or Aegean background.

pelonite.title: Pelonite
pelonite.about: Warriors from or of Pelon or Palet(?)
pelonite.note: Two of David's mighty men, Helez and Ahijah, carry this label. Where it points is unclear, and it may just be another spelling of Paltite.

perezuzza.title: Perezuzza
perezuzza.note: The breach of Uzzah. David gave the threshing floor this name after Uzzah reached out to steady the ark and was struck dead.

philistine.title: Philistine
philistine.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
philistine.note: Seafaring people who settled the coastal plain between Gezer and Gaza, most likely from Caphtor, which the Old Testament elsewhere identifies as Crete.

pirathonite.title: Pirathonite
pirathonite.note: Two men carry the label, both from Pirathon in Ephraim. Abdon son of Hillel judged Israel for eight years and is remembered for his many sons and grandsons. Benaiah was one of David's thirty.

rabbah.title: Rabbah
rabbah.note: Capital of Ammon. David's army besieged it, and Uriah died in that siege, put where the fighting was worst on David's orders.

rapha.title: Rapha
rapha.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
rapha.note: Ancestor of a clan of giants, and the Samuel narrative ties Goliath's kin to him.

ribai.title: Ribai
ribai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ribai.note: A Benjamite from Gibeah, the father of Ittai, one of David's thirty. Nothing further is recorded.

sacar-2.title: Sacar
sacar-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
sacar-2.note: Father of Ahiam, one of David's mighty warriors (1 Chronicles 11:35).

samuel.title: Samuel
samuel.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
samuel.note: Hannah prayed for a son and gave him to the Lord before he was born. He grew up to be the last of the judges and the first great prophet. Israel's first two kings were both anointed by him.

saul.title: Saul
saul.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
saul.note: Israel's first king, found while he was out looking for his father's lost donkeys and anointed by Samuel in private before the tribes confirmed him.

shaalbonite.title: Shaalbonite
shaalbonite.note: Eliahba, one of David's thirty mighty men, came from Shaalbim in Dan, and this is what that makes him.

shage.title: Shage
shage.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
shage.note: Father of Jonathan the Hararite, one of David's mighty warriors. He is named in 1 Chronicles 11:34 for his son's sake.

shama.title: Shama
shama.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shama.note: One of David's mighty men, an Aroerite, named with his brother Jehiel.

shamariah.title: Shamariah
shamariah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shamariah.note: A common name, and this one belongs to a warrior who came over to David at Ziklag (1 Chronicles 12:5).

shammua.title: Shammua
shammua.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
shammua.note: One of David's sons, named in 2 Samuel 5:14 and 1 Chronicles 14:4. Nehemiah 11:17 has the name again for a later man.

shamoth.title: Shamoth
shamoth.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
shamoth.note: "The Harorite," one of David's thirty mighty men. The same warrior is called Shammoth in 2 Samuel 23:25.

shavsha.title: Shavsha
shavsha.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
shavsha.note: One of David's royal secretaries. The same man seems to turn up as Seraiah, Sheva and Shisha in other lists, which is how court names tended to drift.

shebaniah-3.title: Shebaniah
shebaniah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shebaniah-3.note: One of 4 men called Shebaniah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shemaah.title: Shemaah
shemaah.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemaah.note: A Benjamite from Gibeah. His sons Ahiezer and Joash were archers and slingers who came over to David at Ziklag while David was still hiding from Saul.

shemaiah-5.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemaiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shemiramoth.title: Shemiramoth
shemiramoth.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemiramoth.note: David made him one of the musicians when the ark was carried into Jerusalem. He played the harp, a Levite among the temple musicians.

shephatiah-4.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shephatiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

shihor-2.title: Shihor
shihor-2.note: A stream on Egypt's northeastern edge, used as the marker for the southwest corner of the land promised to Israel.

shimea.title: Shimea
shimea.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimea.note: Chronicles uses the name often. It belongs to David's brother at 1 Chronicles 2:13 and 20:7, to one of David's sons at 3:5, and to a Levite at 6:30.

shimri.title: Shimri
shimri.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimri.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

shiza.title: Shiza
shiza.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shiza.note: A Reubenite. His son Adina was one of David's thirty mighty warriors, a captain of the Reubenites, and nothing further is recorded about Shiza himself.

shobab.title: Shobab
shobab.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
shobab.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem after he became king.

shophach.title: Shophach
shophach.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
shophach.note: General of the Aramean army of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, when Ammon hired Arameans against David. Joab's forces beat them and killed him. 2 Samuel spells him Shobach.

sibbecai.title: Sibbecai
sibbecai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
sibbecai.note: He killed a Philistine giant from the same line as Goliath, and he is listed with David's mighty warriors.

simeon.title: Simeon
simeon.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
simeon.note: Jacob's second son. With his brother Levi he killed the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped. Jacob held it against them on his deathbed.

sippai.title: Sippai
sippai.about: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
sippai.note: A Philistine warrior of great size, of the Rephaim, killed by Sibbechai at Gezer. Samuel calls him Saph.

solomon.title: Solomon
solomon.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
solomon.note: David and Bathsheba's son, and Israel's third king. He was rushed onto the throne after his half-brother Adonijah tried to take it while David lay dying. Early on he asked God for wisdom.

tekoite.title: Tekoite
tekoite.note: Someone from Tekoa, the hometown of Amos. The wise woman Joab sent to David about Absalom was a Tekoite, and so were at least two of David's mighty men.

tibhath.title: Tibhath
tibhath.note: Hadadezer of Zobah held this city, and David carried off a great deal of bronze from it. Solomon later used that bronze for the temple. 2 Samuel 8:8 calls the place Betah.

tizite.title: Tizite
tizite.note: The epithet of Joha, one of David's mighty men. The place it points to is unknown.

toi.title: Toi
toi.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
toi.note: King of Hamath. When David beat Hadadezer, who had been at war with Toi, Toi sent his son with gold, silver and bronze to congratulate him.

tyre.title: Tyre
tyre.note: The leading Phoenician port, partly on the mainland and partly on an island offshore, rich from sea trade and purple dye made from murex shells. Its king Hiram sent cedar and craftsmen for David and Solomon. The prophets attacked its pride and said it would fall.

unni.title: Unni
unni.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
unni.note: The name means afflicted. He was a Levite David set to play the harp when the ark came up to Jerusalem.

ur-2.title: Ur
ur-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ur-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

uriah.title: Uriah
uriah.about: Bathsheba's husband living at the time of United Monarchy
uriah.note: Uriah the Hittite, one of David's best soldiers and Bathsheba's husband. David got her pregnant while he was at war and tried to get him to go home to her, and Uriah would not while his comrades were still in the field. So David had him put where the fighting was worst and left there to die.

uriel.title: Uriel
uriel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uriel.note: A Kohathite Levite, named twice in 1 Chronicles 15 among the heads of his family.

uzza.title: Uzza
uzza.note: Uzzah put his hand out to steady the ark when the oxen stumbled, and he died on the spot. David was afraid, and the ark stayed where it was for three months before it went on to Jerusalem.

uzzia.title: Uzzia
uzzia.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzzia.note: One of David's mighty men, from Ashtaroth in Bashan, east of the Jordan.

uzziel.title: Uzziel
uzziel.about: Aaron's uncle living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzziel.note: Kohath's son, and Aaron's uncle. His descendants had their own duties at the tabernacle.

zabad-2.title: Zabad
zabad-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zabad-2.note: One of 6 men called Zabad. This one is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

zachariah.title: Zachariah
zachariah.about: Singer living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah.note: He was a singer and gatekeeper in Chronicles, one of those who played when the ark came up to Jerusalem.

zadok.title: Zadok
zadok.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
zadok.note: The priest who stayed with David through Absalom's rebellion. He would have carried the ark out with the king, and David sent it back. Zadok anointed Solomon, and when Abiathar backed Adonijah and was sent away, Zadok was left as the only high priest.

zebadiah.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zebadiah.note: One of 9 men called Zebadiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

zebulun.title: Zebulun
zebulun.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulun.note: Jacob's tenth son and Leah's last. His tribe's land ran up to the Sea of Galilee, and Isaiah names it with Naphtali as the place where a light would dawn, which Matthew applies to Jesus in Galilee.

zelek.title: Zelek
zelek.about: Warrior Ammonite living at the time of United Monarchy
zelek.note: An Ammonite, and one of David's thirty mighty warriors.

zeruiah.title: Zeruiah
zeruiah.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
zeruiah.note: David's sister, the mother of Joab, Abishai and Asahel. David said the sons of Zeruiah were too much for him.

ziklag.title: Ziklag
ziklag.note: Achish of Gath gave this town in the Negev to David while he was running from Saul, and David lived there more than a year. Amalekites burned it while he was away and took the women and children, and he went after them and got everyone back.

zilthai.title: Zilthai
zilthai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zilthai.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zion.title: Zion
zion.note: The fortified hill on Jerusalem's southeastern ridge that David took from the Jebusites and called the city of David. He built his palace there. Archaeologists have uncovered the Stepped Stone Structure on that ridge, and many tie it to David's time.

zoba.title: Zoba
zoba.note: An Aramean kingdom north of Damascus. Saul fought it, David beat its king Hadadezer and took his chariots and his bronze, and a man from Zobah named Rezon troubled Solomon from Damascus.
